doc: HUD part: the sea orders panel: one modal panel in the middle. Left: the ships that can take an order — `recipients` = [{id, title, meta, image: {icon, enamel}, value, selected, bars: {hull, crew, sails}}]; the chosen companion shows its three bars. Right: `crumb` (the order being completed, on the nested stages), `tiles` = [{id, title, image: {icon}, disabled, pressed}] (orders and their options, three in a row) and `rows` = [{id, title, image: {icon[, enamel]}, disabled, pressed, cooldown}] (ships and forts as enamel tokens) (abilities, targets). A tap acts at once; the first stage has ✕, nested stages have ←; a tap on the scrim closes. Both panes scroll when they are taller than the panel.
